tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /ni gu 'khrul 'khor rtsa 'grel bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ /na mo gu ru/ /rtsa mdud dgrol dang rtsa srong dang*/ /dbu mar sdud dang rtsa 'grems bzhi'
༄༅/ /ni gu 'khrul 'khor rtsa 'grel bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ /na mo gu ru/ /rtsa mdud dgrol dang rtsa srong dang*/ /dbu mar sdud dang rtsa 'grems bzhi'

tei:div.tei:p: oṃ swā sti/ /na mo gu ru/ /rtsa mdud dgrol dang rtsa srong dang*/ /dbu mar sdud dang rtsa 'grems bzhi'o/ /langs 'dren bsgyur dang stod gnon gsum/ / rkang gcig rkang gnyis gcu ba dang*/ /bu chung tshul dang 'phar ba lnga/ kha 'byed gnyis ni snor dang bgrad/ /dbu mar 'jug dang dbu mar 'dren/ /dbu mar sdud pa gsum du bzhed/ /rnam snang ltag gcu don yod grub/ /gzir dang mnyam gzhag rkang g.yab dang*/ /kog langs gsum sprugs zhes bya brgyad/ /rtsa la bzhi dang thig le gsum/ /zug sel lnga dang kha 'byed gnyis/ /rdo rje gar la gsum yin te/ /nyon mongs sel la brgyad yod kyang*/ /gcig tu bsdus na bco brgyad yin/ /dang po skyil krung ro stod lan bdun gcu/ /gnyis pa langs la sked gzir rting 'khrab bdun/ /gsum pa lag gnyis mchan khung brla zur brkyang*/ /bzhi pa sar bsdad lus kun 'phur mnye bya/ /lnga pa spyi bor thal sbyar rting ba brdab/ /drug pa khu tshur g.yas g.yon re mos brkyang*/ /bdun pa mchan khung bsdams la ro stod gcu/ /brgyad dgu gnyis la dbyug mchongs byed par bshad/ /'on kyang da lta lag len de mi byed/ /brgyad pa pus mthil sbyar langs lag brkyang 'khrab/ /dgu pa rkang lag rdeg stabs rting 'khrab gsum/ / bcu pa sor bsnol brang 'gebs lan gsum gcu/ /bcu gcig langs sdod mgo bo bskor lcog sprug /bcu gnyis rting 'khrab gsum mthar sa la 'bebs/ bcu gsum khu tshur brang gnon gcig shos 'phul/ /bcu bzhi kha mig bgrad mtha' brkyang bskum sprug/bco lnga nu rdeg rgod lding sprug dang skor/ /bcu drug snol nas 'then gnon dgyed dgu bya/ /bcu bdun dpung bkab rked pa lan gsum skyog/bco brgyad pa ni nyon mongs sel ba yin/ /byang chub phyag rgya g.yas g.yon steng 'og gcu/ /srin 'dud ltag mnan ro stod g.yas g.yon gcu/ /don grub phyag rgya gzhag sha brdebs pa yin/ /gzir ba 'bar rgya bskor zhing mig bskor bltas/

/mchan khung bsdams shing gcus nas slar yang blta/ /mnyam bzhag rdor skyil pho ba bsdams pa dang*/ /rkang g.yab gan rkyal tsog pu zan spru'i tshul/ /kog langs sdigs mdzub phyogs bcu rnams su bskor/ /gsum sprugs bsdams brkyang bshud cing sprugs pa yin/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu'i chos drug gi /gtum mo'i gzhung khrid 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad yin/ /phyi ma brgyad du phye na nyi shu lnga/ /zhes so/ /de yang rlung sbyong ba zla gcig tsam song ba na/ gtum mo'i stong ra zhag bdun/ gong bu 'thabs pa zhag bdun/ dngos gzhi zhag bdun/ bla ma'i gtum mo zhag bdun/ gos su gyon pa zhag bdun bya/ de nas 'khrul 'khor de rnams bslab ste yang yang sbyangs pas ngal dub med cing sgrib mi dgos par song ba na/ so so'i dmigs pa rnams la thun re re byed kyin sbyangs/ mthar 'khrul 'khor tshar re la dmigs pa thams cad tshar re 'gro bar byed/ thun bzhi'am drug tu tshar re ma chag cing gtum mo la 'bad na yon tan dpag tu med pa 'phral du 'byung nges pa yin no/ /de la sdom tshig gi don rnams bshad par bya ste/ dang po rtsa mdud dgrol ba ni/ skyil krung lus gnad bcas la/ lag pa gnyis pus mo nas drangs te/ brla'i rtsa bar btsugs/ ro stod g.yas dang g.yon du gcu ba lan bdun bdun bya/ gnyis pa rtsa drang por bsrang ba ni/ lus gnad bca' gzhi gong ltar bcas/ lag pa brla'i rtsa bar sleb pa dang*/ kag gi langs la rlung 'phar byas/ lag pa sked gzer gyi ngang nas/ lto ba g.yas bskor g.yon bskor bshang sgor sdig pa re dang*/ ro stod bag tsam g.yas g.yon du gcu ba lhan cig tu bya zhing*/ de rjes rting khrab re dang spel ba lan bdun bya/ 'di rtsa 'khrugs pa sel ba/ skra shad kyis skra gang byed pa dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa dbu mar sdud pa ni/ snga ma'i 'phros la yin na/ rlung 'khrab cig byas pas chog/logs su byed na/ bca' gzhi gnyis pa dang 'dra bar bya/

lag pa khu tshur bcangs pa brla'i phyi 'phongs tshos phyogs la brkyang zhing shed bcug la rting 'khrab gnyis gnyis kyi mtshams su/ 'phar rdeb re bya/ de 'dra lan bdun no/ /bzhi pa rtsa 'grems ni/ rlung bskyur zhig byas nas dang por mgo dang*/ de nas ro stod/ de rjes lag pa/ rjes su smad dang*/ rkang pa brkyang ba la/ 'phur mnye bya/ khyad par du lag pa dang rkang pa'i nywa bzhi rnams la/ phan tshun du bshud pa dang*/ rdung ba byed/ bzhi po de rnams rtsa dag par byed pa'o/ / lnga pa langs te 'grems pa ni/ bca' gzhi gnyis dang 'dra ba las/ lag pa rim pas rtsibs logs brgyud yar brkyang*/ spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ sked pa nyag gis btang*/ thur sel thur du bsdigs pa dang*/ srog steng du drangs/ lkog mas ol mdud drag tu mnan cing*/ 'phar rdeb byed pa las/ rting pa rdeb pa shugs che bar bya/ 'di yang lan bdun bya'o/ /drug pa bsgyur ba ni/ bca' gzhi gong bzhin byas la/ lag gnyis khu tshur brla'i zur la brkyang*/ lus g.yon du gcus nas/ rkang lag g.yas pa drag tu brkyang bskum bya/ lan lag dang lhan cig sor mo yang brkyang bskum bya/ de bzhin du g.yon pa la'ang sbyar/ bdun pa stong gnon ni/ bca' gzhi sngar bzhin las/ lag gnyis sor mo rnams bsnol te brang la bkab/ mthe bos mchan khung logs nas bsdams/ ro stod g.yas g.yon du lan bdun gcu/ de gsum thig le dag byed do/ /brgyad pa rkang gcig pa ni/ bca' gzhi gnyis pa dang 'dra ba las/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i pus mo'i gong la/ g.yas pa'i mthil sbyar/ pus mo g.yas pa g.yas la sgyed/ lag pa gnyis kar brkyang ste/ 'phar rdeb lan gsum byed/ de nyid g.yas g.yon go ldog pa'ang lan gsum/ dgu pa rkang gnyis ni bca' gzhi gnyis pa bzhin las/ rkang lag g.yas pa gnyis mdun du g.yon bskor byas nas/ gyen du cung zad bteg ste/ slar g.yas kyi rgyab zur du/ lag pa sor mo dang bcas pa shad kyi brkyang ba dang*/

rting ba'ang de phyogs su sa la brdabs/ g.yon la'ang de bzhin byed/ 'di'i gzhung las/ brgyad pa dang dgu pa 'di gnyis la thog ma lag pa gcig gis 'khar ba la 'ju ba dang mjug tu gnyis kas 'jus nas ring du 'phar zhing dbyug mchong byed par bshad kyang*/ deng sang lag len mi byed par 'dug/bcu pa gcu ba ni/ sor mo bsnol bas brang dang mchan khung btsir ba bdun pa dang 'dra rung ba las langs pa'i skabs/ mgo dang ltag pa dgye ba'i ngang nas g.yas g.yon lan gsum gcus/ de rjes rlung bskyur byas sa la bsdad nas/ mgo dang ro stod lan gsum gcus/ de nas pus mo btsugs pa'i phyed langs la/ lag pa g.yas pa sngar bzhin/ g.yon pa rgyab nas bskor te dpyi g.yas pa la 'jus nas/ ro stod g.yon du gcus/ de bzhin du go ldog pa'ang bya'o/ /bcu gcig pa bu chung tshul ni/ bsdad la mgo bo bskor zhing mgo lcogs sprug pa lan gsum dang*/ langs nas kyang mgo bo bskor zhing mgo lcogs sprug pa lan gsum rnams bya'o/ /bcu gnyis pa 'phar ba ni/ rting 'khrab lan gsum gyi mthar/ lag pa khur tshur brkyang ste/ /'phongs sa la brdab/ de 'dra lan gsum mo/ /de lnga rlung dang thig le thun mong du dag par byed pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa rtsa dbu ma kha 'byed pa dang po ni/ skyil krung bcas/ lus bsrangs/ lag pa khu tshur gnyis thad kar brkyang ba las/ g.yon khu tshur nu khar rdeg cing mnan/ g.yas 'phongs tshos g.yas kyi phyogs thad ka la bskum khru gang tsam du brkyang*/ de 'dra ba lan gsum byed/ de nyid go ldog pa'ang lan gsum/ 'di la g.yas g.yon snor ba zer/ dbu ma kha 'byed gnyis pa ni/ rlung 'khrab byas nas langs/ lag pa brkyang ste pho ba sa la btsugs/ kha mig gdangs/ yan lag bzhi brkyang bskum bya zhing drag tu sprug pa'o/ /'di la bgrad pa'i mtha' zer/ bco lnga pa dbu mar 'jug pa ni/ bca' gzhi dang bstun nas langs/ rlung thur la sdig cing*/ lag pa brkyang ste nu khar rdaig pa lan gsum bya/

yang lag gnyis khu tshur brla'i zur du brkyang la/ thur sel drag tu 'then pa gsum bya/ yang lag pa rgod gshog bzhin brkyang la rting 'khrab gsum byas nas/ lus drag tu sprug/yang rlung phyir bsal nas kyang drag tu sprug go /bcu drug pa dbu mar 'dren pa ni/ langs te lag pa gnyis bsnol/ khu tshur g.yas g.yon gyi mchan khung dang*/ lag ngar gyis nu ma btsir/ rtsibs logs g.yas dgang*/ mgo g.yon du 'khyog pa dang lhan cig rlung g.yas gyen 'then dang*/ de nyid go ldog pas g.yas thur mnon bya/ g.yon la'ang des rigs 'gre/ de bzhin du ltag pa dgyed la mdun du/ 'then gnon dang sgur la rgyab la'ang 'then gnon bya/ bcu bdun la dbu mar sdud pa ni/ sngar bzhin langs la/ lag pa bsnol/ lag mthil dpung pa g.yas g.yon la bkab/ pho ba g.yas bskor g.yon bskor gsum/ ro stod g.yas g.yon du gcu/ sked pa g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du phar kyog tshur kyog bya zhing 'chun btsal lo/ kha 'byed gnyis/ gar gsum zhes so sor bgrod yang chabs gcig tu yong bas kha 'byed gnyis dang*/ 'jug 'dren sdud gsum ste lnga la rdo rje gar gyi 'khrul 'khor zhes so/ /bco brgyad pa ni nyon mongs sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ste/ de la nang tshan du phye na brgyad yod/ dang po gti mug sel ba rnam snang gi phyag rgya ni/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya snying gar bcas nas/ mdun du brkyang la/ g.yas g.yon steng 'og rnams su gcu zhing*/ nu ma dang pho bar rdeg/rgod pa sel ba ni/ skyil krung ngang nas srin lag gnyis 'dud pa'i sor mor gzhan rnams kyis ltag pa'i chu ba nas mnan te ltag pa dgug/ro stod g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum du drag gcu/ lag pa steng du brkyang ste/ spyi bor thal lcag rgyag/lan gsum khro chig sel ba ni/ lag gnyis pus mo nas blangs te/ gzhag sha brdab cing mdun du brkyang nas/ don yod grub pa'i phyag rgya bcas pa snying ga dang lte 'og tu brdab/

g.yon pa'i lag ngar bsrangs nas gcud do/ /gnod byed gzir ba ni/ skyil krung ngang nas/ lag pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus dang steng dang 'og phyogs nas cung zad rgyab la dgyed de/ g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum skor ba dang lhan cig mig gdangs shing shugs bskyed pa'i lta stangs kyis mig kyang bskor ro/ /zhe sdang sel ba mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /skyil krung byas nas dpyad phrag brdab/ sor bcu bsnol bas brang gi dbus nas bsdams shing*/ gru mo phyir bkyed la g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum gcu ba dang*/ lag gnyis sa gnon byas te/ g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du khro bo'i lta stangs kyis blta'o/ /nga rgyal sel ba 'od dpag med kyi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gi ngang nas lag ngar bsrangs pa'i mnyam bzhag shugs bskyed/ mnyam bzhag btegs nas pho bar rdeg cing bsdams/ yang lag ngar bsrangs pa sogs lan gsum/ de rjes rlung phyir 'bud pa dang lhan cig ha drag po lan gsum brjod/ 'dod chags sel ba ni/ bca' gzhi'i ngang nas rkang pa g.yas g.yon re mos su lan gsum bskor zhing g.yab/ de nas gan rkyal du 'dug ste/ rkang pa g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dang*/ g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum byed/ lag pa nam mkhar brkyang nas zan snol ba'i phyag rgya bya/ bde chen 'bebs pa che ba ser sna sel ba ni/ skyil krung bcas pa las/ kag gis langs te 'dom 'jal brkyang*/ rlung 'khrab bya/ sdigs mdzub byas te g.yas g.yon dang*/ steng 'og dang*/ mdun rgyab tu bskor/ rlung skyar zhig byas la mchog sbyin brkyang lus dgyed par bya/ 'di la kog langs zer ro/ /bde ba 'bebs pa chung ba pa ni/ gsum sprugs zhes bya ba lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis steng nas 'og tu sprug pa dang*/ ro stod drag tu sprug pa la zer/ de yang sems pa'i skyil mo krung bcas nas/ gsum sprugs bya/ de nas lag pa g.yas steng dang g.yon 'og tu byas la bsnol/

lag mthil gyen du bstan/ lag mgo g.yon gyi 'og tu g.yas bcug ste/ g.yas pa'i srin lag gis g.yon pa'i srin lag bsdams/ mdun du brkyangs pas/ lag ngar gcus la bor ba dang*/ lag stabs de nyid go ldog pas kyang gcus la bor/ re re bzhin shugs 'jug thengs gsum gsum byed/ de nas g.yon khu tshur dpung pa'i thad ka nas mdun gyi g.yon zur la brkyang*/ g.yas kyi khu tshur gyi bshud thengs gsum bya/ /g.yas pa la yang de bzhin du bya/ yang gsum sprugs mthar 'bebs bya'o/ /phyi ma 'di la gsum sprugs zer te 'gyod pa dang*/ yid mi bde ba dang*/ rnam rtog sel ba yin/ 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams la/ so sor dmigs pa'i gnad re phal cher la yod de/ rtsa ba'i gzhung tshig las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na 'di rnams ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu'i zhal gyi gdams pa/ rlung sems dbu mar thim pa dang*/ rtsa mdud grol ba'i man ngag rang lus thabs ldan gtso bor gyur pa/ grol lam mchog sgrub kyi man ngag/lus sbyong bco brgyad pa zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i gzhung ni/ zhal shes cung zad gab pa dang*/ tshig mang po'i gseb tu 'thor bas sdud mi shes pa dag mang du yod la/ mi mkhas pas sbyar ba'i sdoms than thun yod srid na'ang lag len gsal po thon pa med par mngon pas/ 'di'i lag len nub tu nye bar mthong ba'i phyir/ mi nub cing rgyas par bya ba'i don du/ dpal ldan shangs pa'i bka' brgyud la mos pa cung zad thob pa/ tā ra nā thas ma sbas shing gsal bar bkod pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// oṃ swā sti/ chos sku kun khyab bde stong zung 'jug dbyings/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi srog tu rtag bzhugs kyang*/ /ma rtogs 'gro kun sgrib gnyis legs gsal phyir/ /tā ra nā thas zab chos thang mar brdal/ /rgyud rgyal chu gter dngos grub rlabs phreng 'khrigs/ /zab don nor bu'i phung po 'bum brdal las/ rmad byung gsung 'bum rgya mtsho 'dir 'ongs pa/

/dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum/ /gang gi bka' 'bum rnam par dag pa 'di/ /skal ldan 'gro la dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /grangs med glegs bam snang brnyan 'bad med du/ /spel phyir rje btsun yon tan bzang po yis/ /spyi lo1996lo la ni/ /'dzam thang gtsang ba'i chos grwa chen po ru/ /spar gyi phyi mo gsar du bskrun pa'i skabs/ /tā ra nā tha'i gsung gi na pod kyi/ /ka nas a yi bar gyi chos rdzas rnams/ /spar du bsgrub pa'i rgyu yon ji song de/ /gtsang skor zhol ma'i sku skyes lnga pa mchog/ngag dbang 'jigs med phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ /sbyar ba'i dge ba chu shel bu mo yis/ /bstan 'gro'i phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /mthun pa'i dge mtshan zla ba yar ngos bzhin/ /gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i dge legs stsol/ /'di las rgya cher bsod nams gang 'grub pa/ /srid zhi'i legs byas kun dang lhan cig tu/ /yongs su zhugs pas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /bla med rgyal ba'i sa la 'khod par shog/drin can bla ma ngag dbang rdor bzang gi /thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ /ma rgan nga zhe pha rgan bso rab dang*/ /a pho stong nyid la sogs 'brel thogs kyi/ /shi gson gang dang gang yod thams cad dang*/ /srid par gnas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus dang*/ /dge tshogs 'di la 'bad pa gang byas rnams/ /sku bzhi mchog gi rgyal sar bsgrod par shog/ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar du yang*/ /tshe ring nad med longs spyod rgyas pa dang*/ /bdud kyi las dang mi mthun phyogs kun zhi/ /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par shog/spar 'di bzhugs pa'i yul phyogs thams cad du/ /dus bzhi snyoms shing lo phyug rtag tu legs/ /'thab rtsod 'khrugs pa'i ming tsam med pa dang*/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling brgyan du shog/ces rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum nang gi na pod kyi par gtsang skor zhol ma'i sku skyes lnga pa ngag dbang 'jigs med phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/

spyi lo1998lo dang*/ rnam dkar byed po mchog sprul dgung grangs don gcig bzhes skabs par bskrun byas pa yin/ skabs der yul gru chen po sde dge nas spyan drangs pa'i yig bzo ba a rnam sogs mi nyer gnyis dang par gyi 'gan khur ba blo gros 'phel dang rdor bzang bcas yin/ rje btsun ngag dbang yon tan bzang pos par byang brtsams yod pa la phran puṇ+yai shrīs kha skong cung tsam bgyis pas 'gro ba rnams la phan pa dang bde ba 'byung bar smon zhu/ par 'di da lta 'dzam thang gtsang ba'i chos grwar bzhugs// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ni gu 'khrul 'khor rtsa 'grel bzhugs/ - PAGE 368 - - PAGE 367 -- PAGE 358 -
